source_documents.title: Schiff base derivatives based on diaminomaleonitrile: Colorimetric and fluorescent recognition of Cu(II), cell imaging application, polymorph-dependent fluorescence and aggregation-enhanced emission

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission peaks move gradually from 462 and 488 nm to 551 and 550 nm for compounds 1 and 2.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 and comparator 2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 1e-5 M, room temperature, hexane to DMF; excitation 420 nm for 1 and 382 nm for 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Compound 1 emission shifts 462 to 551 nm; 488 to 550 nm belongs to 2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solvatochromism alone does not prove TICT; authors discuss dipolar solvent stabilization.

reference_evidence_units.quote: After adding 1 equiv. of Cu2+, the emission intensity reaches its maximum at a wavelength of 501 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 with Cu(II)
reference_evidence_units.statement: Cu(II) switches on 501 nm emission, saturating near one equivalent.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The thousand-fold response at three equivalents belongs to comparator 2.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results indicate a 1:1 ratio for 1-Cu2+ complex, in which one Cu2+ ion is bound with one molecule 1.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1-Cu(II)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text discussion of Job plot and NMR, Figs. S4-S5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose 1:1 binding and chelation-enhanced fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI not inspected; no resolved complex structure or direct PET kinetics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the sensing of Cu2+ by 1 is hardly affected by these commonly coexisting ions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 competition control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: One equivalent Cu(II), two equivalents competing ions; Fig. 4.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Common competing ions have little effect under tested conditions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Hg(II) changes absorption; only Cu(II) gives pronounced fluorescence enhancement. Not universal specificity.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission peaks locate at 527 and 655 nm accordingly.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 polymorphs I and II
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Slow evaporation from dichloromethane/ethanol or dichloromethane/ethyl acetate.
reference_evidence_units.statement: I emits strong yellow at 527 nm; II weaker red at 655 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Main text refers to SI Fig. S9; powder maxima are different.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The prepared powder of the two polymorphs emit yellow and red fluorescence with the fluorescence peaks at 531 and 628 nm, respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 powders
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crushed polymorphic crystals, UV illumination, Fig. 9.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Powder peaks are 531 and 628 nm; crushing also increases intensity.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not merge powder and crystal wavelengths or infer quantum yields.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Such close pack- ing model results in the red shift of the emission peak.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 polymorph II versus I
reference_evidence_units.conditions: X-ray packing Figs. 10-12; parallel layers in II, wavy sheets in I.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors attribute red shift and weaker II emission to closer packing and pi interactions; adjacent-sheet distance reported as 2.559 angstrom.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Packing correlation, not independent exciton identification or internal-motion restriction.

reference_evidence_units.quote: But compound 1 does not display prominent AEE features due to the subtle change of molecular structure.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 negative AEE control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Same THF/water protocol as 2: 5e-5 M, up to 95% water; main refers to Fig. S10.
reference_evidence_units.statement: No prominent AEE is reported for 1, whereas 2 brightens at 90-95% water.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI not inspected; comparator 2 rotation restriction and TICT must not transfer to 1.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit polymorph-packing explanation; no assertion of target AEE.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Cu(II) chelation turns on fluorescence under solution sensing conditions; broad ion-binding family, not cavity inclusion.
